_readme: Draft Nassington walk. [[c:...]] = cyan, not confirmed. Positions are guesses until recorded on site.
name: The Black Horse

layers.essential_history: [[c:Nassington is an old village: farm buildings from around 140 AD have been found here, and excavations still go on.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:Today about 870 people live in the village.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:A cry goes up from the royal hall: the King's ivory chessman is missing. A servant shows you a scratched message.]]

puzzle.title: [[c:The scratched message]]
puzzle.intro: [[c:Each letter has been moved one place along the alphabet. Move each one back a place.]]
puzzle.question: [[c:Where should you go first? (one word)]]
puzzle.reveal: [[c:It says HALL. Start where the King played.]]
puzzle.fallback: [[c:Stuck? Take a hint: hints are free.]]

support: [[c:Support the village: have a drink at the Black Horse before or after the walk.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:From the Black Horse walk west along Church Street to the village hall, about 240 metres.]]
